dataList.content:
Good, good! You nicked my sunglasses!
好，这次你能抢走我的墨镜！
dataList.place:
Lobotomy Corp. Drilling Ship Entrance
脑叶公司支部 钻井船入口
dataList.title:
The Middle's Big Brother
中指 幼兄

The Middle's Big Brother
中指 幼兄
dataList.content:
Too bad~ You'll have to try again!
但是~没有下次！

I... didn't face... all those Waves just to...!
你以为我……越过了……多少浪潮才……！

As long as I can keep trying, I can...!
只要有无限的生命……不管到哪里……！

The mist thickens.
雾更加浓了。

It expands, devouring everything—our futures, our hopes, and any slim chance of victory we had.
未来与希望，甚至一丝微小的胜机，都被那浓雾吞没。

And so does the fog of my sight, of my mind.
视野、意识也随之逐渐模糊。

Will this continue until... either Ishmael gives up...
难道我们……直到以实玛利放弃为止。

Or until he gets tired of this little game?
直到他厌倦这场游戏为止。

Until he simply walks over and crushes my clock?
直到我的头被破坏的瞬间为止，都只能等待吗？

Could Vergilius piece my shattered clock back?
维吉里乌斯会把我破碎的头还原吗？

Is that even possible?
他能够复原吗？

If... I did as Faust told me to and blew up my head...
如果按浮士德所说，引爆头的话……

Not even a shred of me would be...
我连丝毫痕迹都……

dataList.title:
The Middle's Big Brother
中指 幼兄
dataList.content:
... Your repertoire's starting to get old.
……老重复同样的事，我也快腻了。

dataList.title:
The Middle's Big Brother
中指 幼兄
dataList.content:
How about we just zoom right past that and to the main event? I call this clock bashing~!
重头戏~把时钟破坏掉吧？

No...! Dante! Run! Get out of here!
不行……！但丁！快逃！想办法快跑！

dataList.title:
The Middle's Big Brother
中指 幼兄
dataList.content:
That clock fella's gotta be someone so very precious to you, hmm? Just look at her, hanging onto my leg... after all that beating.
都这副惨样了还死拽着我的腿不放，那肯定是对你很重要的人吧。

Not the manager... No...! Not Dante...! Not Dante...!
经理是……但丁……只有但丁不行……！

Should I... press the button?
我该，按下按钮吗。

Is that really going to be my last ever thought?
正当我对自己提出或许是最后的疑问时。

There was a distant sound. Like an answer to my question.
像是在解答我的疑问一般的声音，从远方传来。

That solemn sound tolled clearly through the blinding fog.
不见前方的浓雾中，唯有那声音无比清晰。

dataList.title:
The Middle's Big Brother
中指 幼兄

dataList.content:
It was a skiff. One much smaller, much more modest than ours.
那是一叶小舟。比我们乘坐的船要小上许多，也破旧许多。

From beyond the misty veil, the skiff slowly glided across the water in our direction. On it was a solitary figure holding an oar. A giant harpoon was attached to the bow of the ship.
仅有巨大的鱼叉高高挂起的小木舟，有谁孤身一人坐在当中，从雾中缓缓接近。

dataList.title:
The Middle's Big Brother
中指 幼兄
dataList.content:
But why...?
为什么……？

The Big Brother of the Middle...
但……

Who could probably break that puny skiff in half with his bare hands...
本以为能轻易将那小舟粉碎的他……

... stares at it in stunned silence.
如霎时忘记想说的话一样，盯着那叶小舟。

It became clear that the skiff didn't float here by accident...
如同在诉说着航行的方向并没有错……

... when the figure on the boat began gently rowing in our direction.
小舟上的人撑着桨，缓缓地向我们驶来。

Through the mist, we saw something flash atop the skiff.
穿透浓雾，小舟上有什么耀眼的东西闪闪发光，

The figure hurled something in our general direction. It flew so fast that no human eye could catch it.
随后以肉眼难见的速度飞来。

I didn't even have the time to register that something was thrown... before I noticed that something was piercing the Big Brother's left shoulder.
察觉到的刹那，站在我面前的幼兄的左肩被某种巨大的东西刺中。

Then, a powerful shockwave, far mightier than anything the pirates had fired earlier struck us. The air itself quaked.
随之而来的，是比先前海盗们发射的鱼叉飞过时更为猛烈的轰鸣与冲击。

It was not a distance that most people would even think about jumping across, but...
他纵身越过常人无法跳过的距离……

... the figure leaped over from the skiff to the Lobotomy Corp. Branch gracefully and with agility.
轻盈地，不觉间便跳上了脑叶公司支部的甲板。

The man from the Middle, who so far had appeared unassailable... stumbled, and fell to his knees. His shoulder was skewered.
在我们面前无懈可击的中指干部被刺穿了肩膀，就那样瘫坐在地。

dataList.title:
The Middle's Big Brother
中指 幼兄
dataList.content:
Haah... You...!
哈……你是……

That's when I finally noticed that what the figure had thrown... was a harpoon.
直到这时，我才终于发觉里卡多肩上插着那人投来的鱼叉。

A harpoon too immense to be thrown by a mere person, let alone at such a blinding speed.
以人类单手的力量，是能将那样巨大的鱼叉以肉眼不可见的速度投掷出来的吗。

The hooded figure's arm was wreathed in a familiar light.
那人的手被似乎在何处见到过的光包裹着。

dataList.title:
The Middle's Big Brother
中指 幼兄
dataList.content:
You old geezer...
死老头……

dataList.title:
The Middle's Big Brother
中指 幼兄
dataList.content:
Thought you were out there, fishing... What, you think you're some hot shit now that they made you a Color? Just because you hunted the Marlin Whale? Are you challenging the Middle to a hunt like we're some Whale? That it?
我还以为你只是……在湖里抓抓鱼……听说你获得色彩后才终于捉到一头马林鲸……现在终于老眼昏花到把中指都当成鲸了么？

dataList.title:
The Middle's Big Brother
中指 幼兄
dataList.content:
You're not the kind of idiot that would attack me without knowing the consequences.
你肯定不是不知道攻击我意味着什么的那种人。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
The Middle is no different from a Whale, hm. But that's not why I am here.
中指和鲸没有差别。但，老夫前来不是因为此事。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
I'm just after a fish that got away.
只是来追捕逃跑的鱼而已。

dataList.title:
The Middle's Big Brother
中指 幼兄
dataList.content:
Ha... ha ha... 'Course you are... I'm sure there's no need for me to remind you that the Middle never forgets.
哈……哈哈……你肯定是啊……但中指永不遗忘，一定会牢牢铭记，你知道的吧？

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Feel free to write me down in the remaining margins of that nasty little book, if you wish.
呀，要是那本小家子气的本子里还留着空，就写上吧。

The old man tugs the harpoon lodged in the Big Brother's shoulder.
他拉动鱼叉。

dataList.title:
The Middle's Big Brother
中指 幼兄
dataList.content:
Hngh...
唔……

The 'Big Brother' tried to hold his ground against the harpoon's pull... Until there was a crunch.
“幼兄”为了不被鱼叉拉走而忍耐，瞬间，令人不快的声音响起……

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Those that do not bend... break.
再忍下去可是要坏的。

The harpoon tore off his entire shoulder with it.
他的肩膀被活活扯下。

... It was a force that would have turned most people into tattered meat.
换做普通人，或许会束手无策而全身被撕裂。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Not bad.
瘦死的骆驼比马大。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Would you like to give it another try?
接下来呢。

dataList.title:
The Middle's Big Brother
中指 幼兄
dataList.content:
... Fine, fine! I'll leave for now. But... don't you forget.
……啊啊，行了，行了！就此撤退。但是给我记住了。

dataList.title:
The Middle's Big Brother
中指 幼兄
dataList.content:
The Middle remembers. It doesn't matter what I did here; the Middle will remember everyone and everything that dared to turn their back on it.
中指时刻铭记。与我作何行动无关，敢和中指对着干的混账们，中指必然铭记，永不遗忘。

dataList.title:
The Middle's Big Brother
中指 幼兄
dataList.content:
And the Middle always pays its debts. In whichever form…
并且会想方设法让人偿还。不管用什么方式……

Ishmael and I had no choice but to watch in silent awe as the old man approached us.
以实玛利和我哑口无言，只能呆呆地望着走来的老人。

The harpoon was still in his hand, and if he wished to strike us with it... we could never hope to get out of its way.
带着那个一旦向我们飞来就绝对无法避开的鱼叉一起。

dataList.title:

dataList.content:
I'm looking for the fish that consumed this structure.
老夫在寻找将这建筑吞噬进去的鱼。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Are you two also here to fish?
你们可也是来钓鱼的？
